actions.title: Get customer request
actions.description: Get customer request in Jira Service Desk

input.name: issueIdOrKey
input.label: Issue ID or key
input.hint: ID or key of the customer request.

input.name: expand
input.label: Expand
input.hint: Additional properties to include in the response.

properties.name: defaultName
properties.label: Default name
properties.hint: Untranslated request type name, before any language-pack translation.

properties.name: restrictionStatus
properties.label: Restriction status
properties.hint: e.g. OPEN — whether any customer can raise this request type.

properties.name: canCreateRequest
properties.label: Can create request
properties.hint: Whether the connected user is permitted to raise this request type.

output.name: actions
output.label: Available actions
output.hint: Keys observed so far: addAttachment, addComment, addParticipant, removeParticipant — not necessarily exhaustive, other keys (e.g. transition-related) may appear depending on ticket state.

properties.name: value
properties.label: Value
properties.hint: Plain text/number fields are returned as-is. Fields whose value isn't plain text (checkboxes, multi-select, radio, cascading select, user pickers) are JSON-encoded into this string - use the Parse JSO…

actions.name: get_issue_in_queue_v2
actions.title: Get issue in queue
actions.description: Get issues in queue in Jira Service Desk

input.name: serviceDeskId
input.label: Service Desk
input.hint: Select the service desk. Only the first 100 service desks are shown. Toggle to Enter service desk ID to provide service desk ID manually.

input.name: queueId
input.label: Queue ID
input.hint: Provide queue ID. To find queue ID, login to Jira Service Desk -> Click Projects -> Select the Project -> Select a Queue -> Queue ID can be found at the end of the URL.

input.name: limit
input.label: Limit
input.hint: Maximum number of records to return in the query response. Defaults to 50 . Maximum allowed limit is 50 .

input.name: start
input.label: Offset
input.hint: Starting position from which records should be fetched. Defaults to 0 . Provide a value that is a multiple of the Limit parameter.
